objective: Develop a separately versioned deterministic source-only v1.1 staff-line multi-system detector on the already-spent frozen 20-page development corpus, increasing exact five-line system coverage without using teacher/restored/corpus-coordinate hints during inference and without modifying v1 evidence.

steps.name: truthfulness_and_gate_recheck
steps.action: Confirm PR HEAD, v1 immutability, source-only boundary, rejected current detector disposition and blocked global capability flags.

steps.name: freeze_v1_1_development_plan
steps.action: Commit this plan before any v1.1 tuning or teacher-truth access.

steps.name: diagnostics_only_instrumentation
steps.action: Add source-only diagnostics for row support, candidate segment geometry, scale responses, local spacing estimates, candidate rejection reasons and selected hypotheses. Diagnostics must not alter acceptance decisions.

steps.name: multi_scale_horizontal_morphology
steps.action: Evaluate the preregistered image-width-derived horizontal morphology scales. Combine source-supported horizontal evidence without page-specific selection.

steps.name: local_spacing_strip_prior
steps.action: Estimate staff spacing from source-only repeated row/segment geometry in deterministic vertical strips and use it as a proposal prior, never as teacher-derived truth.

steps.name: source_derived_staff_height_guard
steps.action: Reject implausible five-line clusters using only detected local spacing and cluster span/regularity; retain explicit six-line TAB rejection.

steps.name: source_only_candidate_freeze
steps.action: Run the final preregistered v1.1 configuration on exactly the same 20 source pages, verify every input SHA-256, persist raw detections/config/diagnostics, and freeze with SHA-256 sidecar.

steps.name: open_existing_teacher_truth_after_freeze
steps.action: Only after A6 succeeds, make the existing teacher truth available to scoring.

steps.name: score_frozen_candidate
steps.action: Use the existing scoring/bridge conventions without changing the detector or candidate artifact.

steps.name: decision_and_failure_page_regression
steps.action: Make a PASS/REVIEW/REJECT development decision and regression-check the five previously identified failure pages plus the two staff-absent pages without retuning.

steps.name: final_report_and_reproducibility
steps.action: Verify deterministic reproduction including Python 3.11/3.12 CI and bind results without promoting global Stage 11 capability flags.

preregisteredV1_1Parameters.note: These are fixed development ablation parameters selected before v1.1 implementation. They may not be changed after teacher truth is opened in A7 within the same evaluation cycle.

stopConditions: Do not open teacher truth before A6 source-only candidate freeze.
Do not tune v1.1 after A7 scoring in the same evaluation cycle.
Do not add new pages or independent holdout data.
Do not modify v1 detector or v1 evidence.
Do not promote staff_line based on development targets alone.
Do not change RestoreOutput, Stage 12, production, or semantic-preservation global capability flags.
nextAction: A2 diagnostics-only instrumentation in a separate v1.1 module, followed by A3-A5 in locked order; teacher truth remains sealed until A6 candidate freeze.
